title: Design System: Google Cloud Arcade Tracker

body.purpose: Status text, explanatory copy, table rows, and notes.

label.purpose: Field labels, chips, table headers, small links, and compact controls.

shadows.name: panel-ambient
shadows.purpose: Low ambient separation for top-level panels and notices.

motion.name: state-default
motion.value: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease
motion.purpose: Suggested state transition for controls when adding motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action for reading the public profile.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 34px; border: 1px solid var(--blue, #1a73e8); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--blue, #1a73e8); color: var(--white, #fff); cursor: pointer; font: 700 13px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; padding: 7px 10px; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #155fc0; border-color: #155fc0; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(26, 115, 232, 0.14); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Low-emphasis utility action such as clearing the stored URL.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 34px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9e1ec); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--white, #fff); color: var(--ink, #172033); cursor: pointer; font: 700 13px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; padding: 7px 10px; transition: background 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--soft, #f5f8fc); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(26, 115, 232, 0.14); }

components.name: URL Input
components.description: Full-width profile URL field with clear focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--muted, #5f6b7a); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; border: 1px solid #b9c5d5; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; color: var(--ink, #172033); font: inherit; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--blue, #1a73e8); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(26, 115, 232, 0.14); }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Top-level white surface for calculator, target, and table sections.
components.css: .ds-panel { border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9e1ec); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--white, #fff); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(23, 32, 51, 0.06); color: var(--ink, #172033); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; padding: 22px; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 22px; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted, #5f6b7a); line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: Nested result tile with label and large numeric value.
components.css: .ds-metric { min-height: 112px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9e1ec); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; background: var(--soft, #f5f8fc); color: var(--ink, #172033); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-metric span { display: block; min-height: 36px; color: var(--muted, #5f6b7a); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-metric strong { display: block; margin-top: 12px; font-size: 34px; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Done Chip
components.css: .ds-chip-done { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; background: #dff4e7; color: #137333; padding: 4px 8px; font: 800 12px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; }

components.name: Todo Chip
components.css: .ds-chip-todo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff1cc; color: #8a5a00; padding: 4px 8px; font: 800 12px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; }

components.name: Target Row
components.description: Compact row for Arcade Game and Skill Badge targets.
components.css: .ds-target-row { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9e1ec); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--soft, #f5f8fc); padding: 10px 12px; color: var(--ink, #172033); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; list-style: none; } .ds-target-row strong, .ds-target-row span { display: block; } .ds-target-row span { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--muted, #5f6b7a); font-size: 12px; } .ds-target-row a { display: inline-block; margin-top: 6px; color: var(--blue, #1a73e8); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-chip-todo { flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff1cc; color: #8a5a00; padding: 4px 8px; font: 800 12px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Google Cloud Arcade Tracker uses a calm utility interface: structured, low-noise, and built for quick progress validation. The visual system treats the page as a compact operational console where every panel answers a practical question: what is my current score, what milestone counts, and what should I do next?

The incumbent design borrows Google product colors as functional status accents, not as decoration. White panels, pale blue page wash, restrained borders, and small dense labels keep attention on the milestone math and target lists.
keyCharacteristics: Scan-first calculator layout with clear input, output, target, and rule zones.
Google-color status accents used sparingly for action, success, warning, and error.
Compact card rhythm with 8px corners, thin borders, and low ambient depth.
Indonesian-first copy with direct labels and factual status messages.

rules.name: The Accent-As-State Rule
rules.body: Google colors should communicate state or action. Do not use them as broad decorative fills.

rules.name: The Quiet Neutral Rule
rules.body: Most of the screen stays white, soft blue-gray, ink, and muted text so milestone numbers remain easy to compare.

rules.name: The Numbers Need Air Rule
rules.body: Metric values are the largest text inside panels and sit below compact labels; do not bury calculated results in paragraph copy.

rules.name: The Soft Layer Rule
rules.body: Use one ambient shadow for top-level surfaces and tonal fills for nested content; do not stack multiple shadow styles inside the calculator.

dos: Do keep the page organized around the current workflow: input profile, read results, inspect targets, verify rules.
Do reserve strong color for action, status, validation, and milestone emphasis.
Do keep nested content compact and scannable with borders, pale fills, and short labels.
Do preserve Indonesian labels and factual reward language.
donts: Don't turn this into a marketing landing page or oversized hero experience.
Don't add decorative gradients, illustrations, or color blocks that compete with calculation output.
Don't invent visual proof, testimonials, partner claims, or reward guarantees.
Don't use additional scoring states or progress concepts that are not represented in the app behavior.
